_note: Single source of truth for the sketchbook. Titles, places, days and altitudes are DRAFTS inferred from the Reddit post and its comments - correct them. After editing, re-run the compose step (see README) because the notes are rendered into the spread images.

plates.title: The Valley Opens
plates.note: The river found its line through the valley long before anyone thought to walk beside it.

plates.title: The Gorge
plates.note: Snowmelt going somewhere in a hurry, through rock that has not moved in a very long time.

plates.title: Standing in the Cloud
plates.note: The cloud came up the valley to meet us rather than the other way around.

plates.title: The Upper Waterfall
plates.note: You hear it for an hour before the meadow opens and you finally see the whole drop.

plates.title: Two Walkers, One Cloud
plates.note: Useful reminder of scale: the two specks on the green are people, walking.

plates.title: Snowmelt over Slab
plates.note: Water this colour is only ever a few hours old.

plates.title: Looking Up
plates.note: Straight up through the pines. The only frame on the trek that is wider than it is tall.

plates.title: Cloud in the Gorge
plates.note: The weather sat down in the valley for the afternoon and did not move.

plates.title: Jhaka
plates.note: Slate roofs, rain, and the last village before there are no more villages.

plates.title: Quartz, Found
plates.note: Picked up, turned over, photographed, put back exactly where it was.

plates.title: Above the Cloud Line
plates.note: The point on the trek where the weather is happening underneath you.

plates.title: First Light
plates.note: Twenty minutes of pink, and then it was an ordinary grey morning again.

plates.title: Blue Hour Meadow
plates.note: A clear window between two days of rain.

plates.title: The Long Look
plates.note: Sitting down and looking at it properly is most of what the walk is for.

plates.title: Facing the Cirque
plates.note: Tomorrow's route goes up the left of that snow, which does not look possible from here.

plates.title: The Snow Face
plates.note: Old snow, new cloud, and a very cold wind coming over the top.

plates.title: Red Pack, White Cloud
plates.note: First high-altitude trek, booked two days in advance, walked in Nike Blazers.

plates.title: The Shrine at the Pass
plates.note: Tridents, prayer flags, fog. The highest point, and you cannot see any of it.
